BiblicalUsage: Yeâph means weariness, utter exhaustion, and it stands once, in Daniel's prayer. Gabriel came to him about the time of the evening oblation, and the word for the visit carries weariness in it, the angel coming swiftly and spent by the flight.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God sends His angels swiftly to praying men, and Daniel's prayer was answered before it ended.
